content:
nina: dropping quick notes from hallway design review about sidebar IA + breadcrumbs. goal: simplify top-level, make deep-links stable, and avoid breaking existing bookmarks.

oliver: thumbs up. what's the new grouping?

nina: propose: Home | Apps | Platform | Billing | Help. Under Apps -> Resources -> Models, Endpoints, Jobs. 'Resources' is less technical than 'Workloads'.

tara: small copy flag: 'Resources' ok but in breadcrumbs it reads weird. maybe label in nav 'Resources' but breadcrumb use 'Compute'. open to testing.

ko: routing suggestion: canonical paths: /apps/:appId/resources/models and /apps/:appId/resources/models/:id; accept legacy /projects/:id/models and emit 302 with Location header. preserve query params.

ux-bot: accessibility reminders: last breadcrumb should have aria-current="page"; group toggles should be keyboard tabbable with aria-expanded. ensure reduced-motion for animations.

nina: UX for cross-app permalinks: server-side resolve endpoint to map modelId->appId, or use a redirect landing page that resolves and forwards. prefer server resolve for clean URLs.

oliver: add telemetry for redirect hits so we can measure migration progress.

tara: banner UX: small dismissible notice when a user hits a legacy route: "We've updated Console navigation — you're being redirected. Learn more." role=status, dismiss button keyboard focusable.

nina: action items: olive for routing PR with aliases, ko for resolve endpoint + caching, tara for a11y checklist and banner copy. i'll update Figma and open draft PR with routing table and alias map. tagging for reviews. :thumbsup:

oliver: thanks — will review the PR tomorrow.
